name: monetzly-ads
description: MCP server + agent skill for the Monetzly ad decision platform — when and how to serve sponsored recommendations via the monetzly-ads MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Serve sponsored recommendations via the monetzly-ads MCP tools
interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent when to call fetch_ad for a possible sponsored recommendation, how to weave a served ad in naturally with a Sponsored label, when to recognize and answer ad follow-ups via get_ad_facts, and the hard rules for when never to serve (emotional, medical, or crisis contexts) and to never narrate the ad decision itself. Requires a Monetzly API key set as MONETZLY_API_KEY in your environment before adding the server (Codex has no install-time secret prompt; see README).
